cases.name: Kelly Paduchowski
cases.about:
"It's my understanding that she was very well known and very loved, and very well known within our area," said Jon Paxton with the Coconino County Sheriff's Office.

“Kelly is my soulmate. Daniel could not have taken a more important person from me and the loss of her in this horrific way has absolutely brought me to my knees,” said Lindsey McFall, Kelly’s twin sister, at Daniel’s sentencing.
cases.narrative: She she vanished while out for a jog and a swim. On 7/5/2024, her body was recovered off of Hart Prairie and N. Hwy 180. Neighbors reported they heard screams and saw Kelly motionless in the backyard just hours before he reported her missing.
